- New Plants rows: Chanterelle, Raw Rice and Banana / Plantain, in every language.
- A game patch that only moves the game's code should no longer need an update: the HD maps, heat maps, smooth silhouettes and G G's ore surfaces find the game's functions themselves when the mod starts. If a patch changes something they need, they turn off on their own.
- On a new game build, if the game dies within two minutes of play, those features stay off on that build at the next start, so they can't crash you in a loop. Delete greeneye\unlock-map-markers\untested-build.txt to try again.
- Greeneye Loader 1.2.2: logs are written in the background, so a slow drive can't stall the game through them. This may help the freezes HadToRegister reported.
Reported bugs fixed:
- Missing plants (reported by antisocialIan).
